Lore: Relic Chime

A hollow mithral tube that Netherese librarians used instead of keys. It has the following Powers:

  • Opening: Strike the chime to Cast @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.q52wvmwELTAsuPgM]{Knock} on one object within Near. Three uses, after which the chime cracks and is spent.

Value: 2500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
